fixed_body.role: static mill body including stationary hub/face; blade-occluded regions repaired

movable_rotor.role: blades/sails + lattice frames with transparent hub opening; rotates about rotor_pivot

hub_center.method: annulus fit to hub-face outline (face r~29) + visual overlay verification on 384x384 plane
hub_center.note: knockout disc r<40 keeps full hub face + wooden ring on fixed_body; rotor shows body hub through opening

rotor_pivot.note: identical to hub_center; runtime rotates movable_rotor about this point; tower/base/hub-face stay fixed

reconstruction: compositing movable_rotor over fixed_body reproduces the upscaled accepted reference (mean abs diff 0.019 over visible pixels; residual diffs are 1-2px feather seams at separation boundaries)
